signIn.title: Sign in to AcuDx
signIn.lede: AcuDx is an education-only clinical reasoning simulator. Sign in through your institution, or create a local profile to start practising.
signIn.ssoNote: The production path, enabled by your medical school or training programme.
signIn.ltiHint: Moodle, Canvas, or your virtual learning environment
signIn.unavailableNote: Available once your institution connects AcuDx.
signIn.createHint: Set up a local profile stored only in this browser.
signIn.continueAsHint: Resume your saved profile on this device.
signIn.eduNote: For clinical education and assessment only. Not for real patient care, and not a medical device.
signIn.privacyNote: Your local profile stays in this browser. No password is collected.

onboarding.title: Tell us who you are
onboarding.lede: This sets your name, role, and language across AcuDx. You can change it anytime from your account.

account.title: Your profile
account.lede: Update how AcuDx identifies you, or sign out of this device.

form.roleHint: Sets which surfaces AcuDx shows you.
form.institutionPlaceholder: e.g. Hacettepe University Faculty of Medicine
form.avatarHint: Pick an identicon. No photo needed.
